title: Provision Hearth
pages: Craft the controller from sealed steel plates, bricks and a smoker. Set it directly above a lit campfire. Put a smoker on each diagonal corner at controller height to form a raised X around it.

Right-click the formed controller with four times a hearth recipe's input count to load one four-smoker heat. The held stack loses only that amount; the controller smokes it over 40 ticks and produces four results. A second hand-fed heat is refused while stock or output waits, without taking items. Right-click with an empty hand to collect the finished food, or extract it from a configured output side. Extinguishing the campfire or removing any smoker pauses processing without consuming the loaded stock.

Twenty-one exclusive arcana_industry:hearth_smoking recipes cure trail rations, fuel and a t3 gate material: four raw beef, chicken, porkchop, mutton, rabbit, cod, salmon or kelp into five cooked or dried pieces (the slow smoke wastes less than a smoker); one potato into one baked potato; one spider eye into one fermented spider eye (the Condenser reverses two for two); sugar cane into sugar; nine wheat into four loaves of bread; nine dried kelp into a dried kelp block; honeycomb into a honey bottle; four birch, spruce, acacia or dark oak logs into five charcoal; four chorus fruit into five popped chorus fruit for End building; two rotten flesh into one smoke-cured leather, a drop sink for zombie farms; and leather into Cured Lashing, a smoke-tanned cord needed once for the Leaching Vat craft and once for an Electrolyzer corner.

This recipe type is exclusive to the Provision Hearth and separate from vanilla minecraft:smoking, so other mods' or vanilla's furnace-smoker recipes do not apply here. JEI lists its hearth smoking recipes under the Provision Hearth catalyst, with the quadrupled input and four separate output stacks shown. For automation, a hopper above the controller or a compatible pipe inserts recipe stock into a buffered input slot; the hearth waits until four batches are present, then smokes them in 40 ticks into four results. The lit campfire fills the bottom face, so sneak-right-click a free side with an empty hand to cycle it from input to output (then disabled) and pull products with a pipe or other Forge item handler; right-click with an empty hand to collect them yourself. Unmatched stock is refused, a missing smoker or unlit campfire pauses work without consuming stock, and both buffers and face modes are saved. It has no FE or fluid port.
